أستنقع (form X)
# أَسْتَنْقِعُ (ʔastanqiʕu) /ʔas.tan.qi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْقَعَ (istanqaʕa)
# أَسْتَنْقِعَ (ʔastanqiʕa) /ʔas.tan.qi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْقَعَ (istanqaʕa)
# أَسْتَنْقِعْ (ʔastanqiʕ) /ʔas.tan.qiʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْقَعَ (istanqaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
